verdict.rationale: Cognee ships a well-documented Python SDK (`.remember`, `.recall`, `.improve`, `.forget`) plus CLI, REST API and Docker image, letting AI-native developers build directly against official interfaces (cognee-docs-1–4, 16, 41-43, 26, 36). Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python (e.g., JS/TS), independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability, and OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe confirms 404s for openapi.json).
